internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Checkout Service Due to Payment Service Token Errors
internal.body:
At 12:25 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as an error injection in the payment service related to invalid tokens, coinciding with a spike in the paymentFailure flag to 10%. This caused increased errors and latency in the checkout process.

Actions taken included disabling the paymentFailure flag at 12:45 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery and normalization of error rates. The frontend and checkout services also showed elevated latency but were secondary to the payment service errors.

The incident was resolved by 12:45 UTC with verified recovery metrics showing error rates returning to normal levels.

Key timeline:
- 12:25: Alert received
- 12:45: Diagnosis confirmed payment error injection
- 12:45: PaymentFailure flag disabled
- 12:45: Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing errors
external.body: Between 12:25 and 12:45 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to errors in the payment processing system. The issue was identified and resolved within 20 minutes, restoring normal service operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
